description: If \(p\) presents the binary approximation \(a\) at \(x\), its initial value there is zero, its counter there never exceeds \(n\), and its values there eventually equal \(\ell\), then the specified clipped guess \(Q(n,p,s,x)\) eventually equals \(\ell\). Moreover \(x\in R_{n,p}\) if and only if \(\ell=1\). All hypotheses concern only the fixed input \(x\).
